en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4100 - Muhammad ibn Hassan narrated from Abi Imran al-Armani, from Abdullah ibn al-Hakam, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who became bankrupt and owed debts to some people, some of whom held collateral (ruhun) while others did not. The man then died, and his remaining wealth was insufficient to cover his debts.
Imam (as) said: "All that he left behind, including the collateral and other possessions, shall be divided among the creditors in proportion to their shares of the debt."
